lines.text: Team Rocket...\nWe’ve been cracking down on them, but they\r\nkeep coming!

Are you the one who chased away Team Rocket?\c
No, don’t say anything. I can tell just by
the look in your eyes.\c
Thank you. Please take this.
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Police Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] from the police officer!
You put the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Police Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] in your Clothing Trunk!
You make a better police officer than me.\nThank you for protecting Saffron City’s peace.
